reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly identifies CoCrFeMnNi as a eutectic high-entropy alloy (it is a single-phase FCC alloy) and proposes a mechanism (recovery/recrystallization) that typically reduces strength, making the claimed simultaneous improvement contradictory.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and would decisively falsify the hypothesis, but the hypothesis itself is based on a fundamental material misidentification.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it targets the wrong material class (non-eutectic) and the proposed mechanism is unlikely to yield the claimed simultaneous improvement.
